cells.n: Orthodox lexicon requires 'became' for aorist indicative context
aorist subjunctive with ἐάν; 'became' fits the conditional future context better than present 'becomes'
aorist middle imperative 2nd sg.; 'became' captures the aorist aspect in the imperative mood, prohibiting entry into a state
Imperative form; lexicon prefers 'became' as base form
Participle 'becoming/being executed' fits the context of sentence being carried out; 'became' would be aorist indicative but this is present participle feminine nominative
